overview.text: The Chernigov-Elets icon is linked with the tradition of an appearance in a spruce or fir tree and a monastery near Chernigov. The OCA distinguishes it from another Yelets image with a different observance.
overview.reason: Necessary concise account of the named copyrighted publication; full-text reproduction permission has not been established. Traditional events and published interpretations remain attributed.

blocks.text: The photographed example is a later copy of the named Chernigov-Elets icon. Its inscription commemorates the preservation of Emperor Alexander II and names pupils of the Zlatopol gymnasium with the date 5 February 1880. The old painting and the modern photographer’s CC BY-SA 4.0 grant are separately identified.

The pictured 1880 example illustrates later reception.
